items.title: Anthropic Redesigns Source Control for Extreme Scale
items.why: This article details how Anthropic built a custom alternative to Git to manage the dramatically increased rate of changes in their large codebase, offering insights into version control at scale.

items.title: AI is Mass Decompiling Games, Raising Opportunities and Concerns
items.why: This piece explores the emerging trend of AI-powered game decompilation, which has significant implications for software reverse engineering, security, and intellectual property.

items.title: Deno Joins Cloudflare, Merging Web Runtime and Edge Computing Efforts
items.why: The Deno team's move to Cloudflare signals a strategic shift in the web platform landscape, particularly for developers leveraging serverless functions and edge computing.

items.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5: Anthropic's New Fast, Low-Cost AI Model

items.title: Profiling Python 3.15 with Flame Graphs and Source Heatmaps for Performance
